title: 祭りはひとりじゃできやしねえ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not wanting Inari One's relationship with her hometown to sour, I reach out to Chief and explain her true intentions for running in the regionals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: He then decides to visit Tracen Academy, where he scolds Inari One—not for running in the regionals, but for not standing proud and challenging the Oi racers directly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: His harsh reprimand works, and a fire is lit within Inari One, burning away any fears she had about her upcoming battle for the top.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One declares she'll be the one to conquer the summit of the regionals. The misunderstanding thus cleared up, she decides to face off directly against the racers of Oi.
